source.name: Back-derived from The Opportunities Party's own 2026 Land Value Tax costing
source.assumptions: No consolidated national land-value total is publicly indexed (checked QV, LINZ, Stats NZ). These 'value' figures are back-calculated from TOP's own $24bn/year revenue estimate at their stated rates (1.75% urban, 0.5% rural), assuming an 85%/15% urban/rural split of that revenue (itself an illustrative assumption, not sourced) - urban value = $20.4bn / 1.75% = $1,165,714,286K; rural value = $3.6bn / 0.5% = $720,000,000K. TOP's own $24bn figure has itself been publicly questioned (NZ Initiative) as not transparently derived. Treat this whole dataset as a rough approximation. See TODO.md.
